zh: Open-AutoGLM 防复锁与画面保全：执行手机任务默认保持屏幕解锁状态（no_auto_lock），防止任务完成后设备自动重新锁屏导致复合截屏截到锁屏界面。
移动端持续秒级流式心跳：任务轮询期间每 2 秒下发动态耗时与执行进度，彻底防止 iOS CFNetwork 与云代理触发 60 秒闲置超时（The request timed out）。
息屏全黑帧智能唤醒与重试：截屏捕获息屏全黑画面时自动调用设备唤醒与 PIN 码解锁，并在 CI 测试套件中强化浏览器沙箱清理稳定性。
en: Open-AutoGLM auto-lock prevention: keep target screen unlocked after task completion (no_auto_lock), preventing compound instructions from capturing lock-screen frames.
Mobile continuous per-second streaming heartbeats: emit live execution duration every 2s during polling, eliminating 60s iOS CFNetwork and proxy idle request timeouts.
Black screen auto-wake & unlock retry: automatically wake and unlock device via PIN when black frames are detected during screenshots, plus enhanced CI sandbox cleanup resilience.
